html:
Console design spec (2026-09-13, console stream)

Binding on the look and structure of swesim/dashboard/**. Requirements come from the hosted-pipeline brief §2.5 and §2.5.1; data names from 2026-09-13-interfaces.md §2 (row models, IndexReader). Colour decisions follow the dataviz skill; the validator output is pasted below and saved at workspace/evidence/console/palette-validation.txt.

1. Pages and the one question each answers first

Route Page First-screen question Reader calls
/ Home What is running and what changed? trials(status=running), workflows(limit), spend(), funnel(), counts
/scenarios, /scenario/{id} Scenarios What tasks exist and how hard are they? scenarios, scenario_versions, scenario
/trials, /trial/{id} Trials / Episode What happened to each attempt? trials, trial, exchanges(evaluator) + per-trial artifacts
/candidates Candidates Where does the creation funnel lose candidates, and why? funnel, candidates
/workflows, /workflows/{id} Workflows What did Temporal do? (status, params, failure, cost; deep link for history) workflows, workflow + console.job_progress
/review, /review/{id} Review queue What needs a decision? console.review_queue + scenario artifacts
/leaderboard Leaderboard How do models compare on informative tasks? leaderboard, scores
/db, /db/{table} Database browser What is in the index, and is it fresh? table, rebuilds
/artifacts Artifact browser Which file did this number come from? Layout + os.scandir (the one non-reader page)
/create, /run Create / Run What exactly will run if I press this? console.validate_*, cli_for_*
/spend Spend Who is spending what, against which cap? spend, costs

Every number links to its artifact (/artifacts?path=... or a file route). Ids and hashes render as <span class=id title=full> shortened to 12 chars; click copies the full value. Temporal event histories are never duplicated: every workflow row carries Settings.workflow_url(workflow_id, run_id).

2. Type scale, grid, surfaces

  • Fonts: UI --font-sans (system humanist sans stack), ids/hashes/diffs/logs --font-mono. Scale (px): 12 / 13 / 14 / 16 / 20 / 26 / 40 (hero). Line height 1.5 body, 1.2 headings/values. Tabular figures only in table columns and axis ticks; proportional on stat tiles and the hero figure.
  • Spacing: 8-px grid (--s-1..--s-7 = 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48). Radii 4 / 8 / 14. Borders 1 px hairline --line.
  • Surfaces (light / dark): page #f9f9f7 / #0d0d0d; card #fcfcfb / #1a1a19; inset #f3f2ee / #2c2c2a; overlay #ffffff / #232322. Ink primary #0b0b0b / #ffffff, secondary #52514e / #c3c2b7, muted #6f6e69 / #9d9c93 (both ≥ 4.5:1 on every surface — measured 4.56–9.72, see evidence).
  • Accent (interactive only): #1c5cab light text / #86b6ef dark text; fill #2a78d6 / #3987e5. Focus ring 2 px accent.
  • Theme: prefers-color-scheme default, overridden by html[data-theme] from the nav toggle (persisted in localStorage).

3. Palettes

Categorical — model families, fixed order, never cycled (slot → family; light / dark): 1 Anthropic #2a78d6/#3987e5 · 2 OpenAI #eb6834/#d95926 · 3 DeepSeek #1baf7a/#199e70 · 4 GLM/Z.ai #eda100/#c98500 · 5 Qwen #e87ba4/#d55181 · 6 Kimi #008300/#008300 · 7 MiniMax #4a3aa7/#9085e9 · 8 gpt-oss #e34948/#e66767 · other #898781 (de-emphasis, not a slot). Family is derived from the model id (anthropic/, openai/, openrouter/deepseek/, openrouter/z-ai/, openrouter/qwen/, openrouter/moonshotai/, openrouter/minimax/, openrouter/openai/gpt-oss*). Text never wears a series colour; a swatch beside the text does. Charts with more than three families on one axis fold to "other" plus the table, or facet.

Validator output (node scripts/validate_palette.js ... --mode light --surface "#fcfcfb"):

Palette (light, surface #fcfcfb, categorical): 8 slots
  [PASS] Lightness band         all 8 inside L 0.43–0.77
  [PASS] Chroma floor           all 8 >= 0.1
  [PASS] CVD separation         worst adjacent #eda100↔#1baf7a ΔE 9.1 (protan) · tritan 5.8
  [PASS] Normal-vision floor    worst adjacent #e87ba4↔#eda100 ΔE 19.6 (normal)
  [WARN] Contrast vs surface    below 3:1 — relief required (visible labels or table view): [["#1baf7a",2.74],["#eda100",2.11],["#e87ba4",2.62]]
  → ALL CHECKS PASS   exit=0
Palette (dark, surface #1a1a19, categorical): 8 slots
  [PASS] Lightness band         all 8 inside L 0.48–0.67
  [PASS] Chroma floor           all 8 >= 0.1
  [PASS] CVD separation         worst adjacent #c98500↔#199e70 ΔE 8.4 (protan) · tritan 8.7
  [PASS] Normal-vision floor    worst adjacent #d55181↔#c98500 ΔE 19.3 (normal)
  [PASS] Contrast vs surface    all 8 >= 3:1
  → ALL CHECKS PASS   exit=0

The light-mode contrast WARN is relieved as the skill requires: every chart ships direct labels and a table view.

Sequential (magnitudes: pass rate, cost, cells of the per-scenario matrix) — blue 100→700 (#cde2fb … #0d366b), lightest = near zero; dark mode anchors the ramp from 600 downwards. Validated monotone (--ordinal: "Lightness monotone PASS"); adjacent-ΔL and CVD gates are categorical/ordinal-only and not applied to a continuous ramp.

Status (fixed, never themed; always icon + label, never colour alone): valid/good #0ca30c ●, running/pending #fab219 ◐ (pulses), failed/invalid/critical #d03b3b ✕, unresolved/serious #ec835a ◇, neutral/archived gray ○. Text variants (--good-ink etc.) are the ≥ 4.5:1 steps listed in the evidence file. Difficulty labels use status tokens: informative = good, saturated = neutral gray, broken = critical.

Funnel decision. An 8-step ordinal ramp cannot clear the ordinal gate (adjacent ΔL ≥ 0.06) with the documented 13-step ramp (measured 0.046–0.049 per step), so the creation funnel is drawn as horizontal stacked bars per stage in status tokens (kept = good, rejected = critical, error = serious, pending = gray) with 2-px surface gaps, direct labels and a table twin. Cost if wrong: one chart re-skinned.

4. Component inventory

nav (persistent left rail, live counts from /api/counts: running trials, awaiting review, funnel pending; global search box → /search?q=; theme toggle; Temporal link) · breadcrumbs · stat tile (label, value, delta/source link) · hero figure (one per page, ≥ 40 px) · table (sticky header, sortable, column filters, paging, right-aligned numerics, mono ids, empty state that says what to do next, CSV export; server declares columns once and the client re-renders from the same spec on poll) · chip (status icon + label) · id (shortened, copy-on-click, full on hover) · model chip (family swatch + tier label) · meter (patience; same-ramp track) · funnel (stacked bars) · bar chart (one axis, ≤ 24-px bars, 4-px caps, legend + selective direct labels, <title> tooltips with keyboard focus, table twin) · heat matrix (sequential cells, value in cell) · timeline / transcript (two-party bubbles: agent left, stakeholder right; question and confirmation highlighted; patience after each reply; exchange type badge) · code/diff block (mono, +/- washes) · confirm dialog (<dialog>: exact CLI equivalent, params table, token expiry, Confirm/Cancel; focus trapped) · banner (ok/warn/error with the CLI fallback) · tree (artifact browser, <details> per directory, sizes, sha256, preview).

5. Evaluator gate and mutations

Identity(email, evaluator) from IAP headers (X-Goog-Authenticated-User-Email + JWT X-Goog-IAP-JWT-Assertion verified with google.auth's id_token.verify_token(..., certs_url="https://www.gstatic.com/iap/verify/public_key", audience=settings.iap_audience)), evaluator = email in Settings.evaluators; no headers → anonymous, evaluator=False. ?evaluator=1 is gone. Evaluator-only material (redacted_terms, withheld_sentences, disclosed_fact_ids, tier, regenerated, audit, tool audit, author-only facts, hidden test assets, oracle, judge/draft metadata, raw record/transcript/spec) renders only for evaluator identities, behind an explicit toggle. A test enumerates every non-evaluator route and asserts none of those keys or sentinel values appears.

Mutations (create, run, cancel, approve/reject, label, retry candidate, index rebuild) are two-step: POST /api/<action>/preview returns the exact CLI equivalent and an HMAC-signed token bound to the canonical params, the actor and a 10-minute expiry; the second POST /api/<action> carries the token. Both check Origin scheme+host+port against Settings.console_url (or the request's own origin). Every attempt writes an OperatorActionRow (add_operator_action on the store, or evidence/console/actions.jsonl when the index is disabled).

6. Accessibility and performance

Keyboard: every control is a native element or has tabindex/role; skip link; focus-visible ring; tables sort with Enter/Space on headers; dialogs trap focus and close on Escape. Contrast ≥ 4.5:1 for all text tokens (measured, evidence file). No information by colour alone (icon + label on every status; swatch + name on every series). Pages render from one reader call set with limit ≤ 500; live updates poll JSON endpoints (/api/...) and patch rows in place, holding the previous render at reduced opacity while a refetch is in flight; no full reloads.
